observed_rules: All six required fields must be present.
expires_at MUST NOT appear alone; missing peer fields make the waiver invalid.
owner MUST reference a human reviewer or accountable maintainer (not an AI agent label).
evidence_ref MUST point to a verify artifact path under artifacts/verify/.
expires_at MUST be enforceable: TASK-1025 gates MUST reject expired waivers as blocking.
scope MUST be a non-empty list of repo-relative paths.
Date format: YYYY-MM-DD; expiration check uses lexicographic comparison against Asia/Taipei date.

observed_notes: Waivers MUST be declared inside a decision artifact under '## Guard Exception' or an equivalent structured block; narrative-only paragraphs are NOT valid waivers.
All six required_waiver_fields MUST be present; missing any one invalidates the waiver regardless of other content.
owner MUST reference a human reviewer or accountable maintainer (not an AI agent label).
evidence_ref MUST point to a verify artifact path under artifacts/verify/.
expires_at MUST be present and enforceable; expired waivers MUST be treated as invalid by any future matrix validator.
v3.5.0 explicitly forbids creating a standalone waiver registry or style debt registry; if data later justifies one, it is deferred to v3.5.2.

existing_waiver_semantics_inventory.observed_description: decision artifact ## Guard Exception with Exception Type=allow-scope-drift cites Scope Files; verify artifact must echo references to those waivered files

observed_planned_cases.title: Drift covered by valid waiver -> reason_code=waivered_until:<date>; exit 0
Drift covered by expired waiver -> reason_code=waiver_invalid:expired:<date>; exit 1

observed_implementation_status_at_task_1: TASK-1037 implemented twelve of the matrix cases as implemented_with_limitations; GCLI-QUALITY-SYNC-005 and GCLI-QUALITY-SYNC-006 are not yet locked at the CLI boundary.

field_descriptions.waiver_id: stable identifier; unique within the registry; recommended pattern WAIVER-<plan-version>-<NNNN>
field_descriptions.rule_id: the rule the waiver targets (e.g. QC-SYNC-001, AOM-009); must match an existing rule_id in the consuming policy
field_descriptions.scope: non-empty list describing what the waiver covers; see scope_policy for allowed shapes
field_descriptions.owner: human reviewer or accountable maintainer; not an AI agent label
field_descriptions.evidence_ref: repo-relative path under artifacts/verify/ (or other Evidence Ref policy allowed prefix); must resolve under evidence-ref-policy.v3.5.3.json
field_descriptions.expires_at: ISO-8601 date YYYY-MM-DD with explicit timezone (or normalized to Asia/Taipei) per quality-gate-policy.v3.5.json#waiver_policy.schema.rules
field_descriptions.created_by_task: TASK-XXXX of the lifecycle that authored the waiver
field_descriptions.status: lifecycle state from waiver_lifecycle_states (active / expired / revoked / superseded / invalid / advisory_only)
field_descriptions.reviewer: optional reviewer id (e.g. arcobaleno) when distinct from owner
field_descriptions.supersedes: optional waiver_id that this waiver replaces
field_descriptions.related_artifacts: optional list of repo-relative paths for additional context
field_descriptions.revoked_at: optional ISO-8601 timestamp when status transitions to revoked
field_descriptions.revoked_by_task: optional TASK-XXXX that performed the revocation
field_descriptions.superseded_by_waiver_id: optional waiver_id that supersedes this one

waiver_lifecycle_states.description: Waiver is in effect; expires_at is in the future and all required fields are present and valid.
Waiver's expires_at is in the past or equal to the comparison date in Asia/Taipei.
Waiver was explicitly revoked by a later decision artifact; revoked_at and revoked_by_task SHOULD be recorded.
Waiver was replaced by another waiver (superseded_by_waiver_id SHOULD be recorded); the superseding waiver carries the active obligation.
Waiver fails schema validation (missing required field / unknown field / malformed expires_at / forbidden scope shape / forbidden evidence_ref).
Waiver applies to an advisory-only finding (e.g. QC-RUFF-001); never required because advisory findings do not gate exit_code; reserved for documentation parity with quality gate advisory surface.

expiration_policy.expires_at_format: YYYY-MM-DD with explicit timezone token or normalized to Asia/Taipei
expiration_policy.comparison_strategy: lexicographic comparison against Asia/Taipei date per quality-gate-policy.v3.5.json#waiver_policy.schema.rules
expiration_policy.far_future_threshold: expires_at more than 365 days beyond created_at SHOULD be flagged for owner+evidence justification at runtime; runtime extraction may treat the threshold as advisory rather than blocking

allowed_categories.description: Drift recorded as baseline at TASK-1024 time; not new or modified after baseline; aligns with quality-gate-policy.v3.5.json behavior (b) of QC-SYNC-001.
Remediation is approved but deferred to a later lifecycle; expires_at MUST point at the deferral horizon.
Waiver is required because of an external dependency (e.g. upstream library bug); external dependency reference MUST appear in evidence_ref or related_artifacts.
Tooling cannot detect or fix the underlying issue; expires_at MUST point at the tooling-fix horizon.
Waiver covers a known transition period (plan version cutover, runner sha drift, etc.); expires_at MUST point at the transition end.
Finding is a false positive; evidence_ref MUST point at evidence demonstrating the false positive analysis.

rejected_patterns.description: reason_code is missing or empty string.
reason_code claims temporary scope but no expires_at is present.
reason_code attributes the waiver to an AI agent's preference; AI agent labels are not accountable owners.

owner_ai_agent_labels_rejected: any AI agent label or model id
owner_policy.owner_canonical_human_set_reference: owner SHOULD reference a canonical human reviewer; current canonical reviewer set is recorded at artifacts/governance/precommit-check-policy.v3.5.json#checks[?check_id=PCACC-003].canonical_reviewers

evidence_ref_policy.evidence_ref_alignment_with_rrc_5: When the waiver targets a scope-drift finding, the verify artifact MUST echo the Scope Files referenced by the decision artifact's ## Guard Exception per evidence-ref-policy.v3.5.3.json#required_ref_contexts.RRC-5; missing this echo fails with reason_code=missing_paths.

allowed_scope_shapes.description: scope is a single rule_id token (e.g. QC-SYNC-001); waiver targets the named rule across the entire repo as long as additional shape constraints are present.
scope is a non-empty list of repo-relative paths; waiver applies only to findings rooted at those paths.
scope is a TASK-XXXX id; waiver applies only to findings emitted under that task lifecycle.
scope is a single artifact ref (path or path#anchor); waiver applies only to findings on that artifact.
scope is a source/template pair ref (baseline_id or sourcepath+templatepath); waiver applies only to QC-SYNC-001 pair-level findings.

matching_semantics.scope_path_normalization_rules: forward_slash_only; no parent traversal; no absolute paths; no Windows drive letters; aligned with evidence-ref-policy.v3.5.3.json#local_artifact_constraints

validation_semantics.exit_code_mapping_if_runtime_consumed: exit_code=1 when blocking violations remain after applying valid active waivers; exit_code=2 when registry load itself fails (missing / malformed JSON / schema_version mismatch / forbidden scope shape / forbidden evidence_ref); exit_code=0 only when no blocking violation remains

interaction_notes.qc_sync_post_baseline_drift: Per quality-gate-policy.v3.5.json#gates[?gate_id=QC-SYNC-001].behavior, valid unexpired waivers map to reason_code waivered_until:<date>; expired or schema-invalid waivers map to waiver_invalid:<reasons>; the prototype preserves these reason_code shapes so any future runtime extraction does not regress the QC-SYNC-001 contract.
interaction_notes.quality_gate_policy: quality-gate-policy.v3.5.json#waiver_policy currently uses an explicit_policy_waivers_array with registry_forbidden=true; the prototype does NOT change that; future runtime extraction MUST gate registry consumption behind a new CLI flag (mirroring TASK-1035's --evidence-ref-policy flag) so the default behavior remains the policy-embedded waivers array.
interaction_notes.pcacc: PCACC active surface is bounded to PCACC-001..PCACC-004 per artifacts/governance/precommit-check-policy.v3.5.json; the prototype does NOT introduce PCACC-005 and does NOT change the PCACC active check count; PCACC-002 remains the only check that consults the Evidence Ref registry and continues to do so under evidence-ref-policy.v3.5.3.json.
interaction_notes.evidence_ref_policy: Waiver evidence_ref MUST resolve under evidence-ref-policy.v3.5.3.json; specifically, RRC-5 (waiver_evidence_ref) requires the verify artifact to echo Scope Files cited by the decision artifact's ## Guard Exception block; the prototype inherits this constraint without modification.
interaction_notes.golden_cli_coverage: GCLI-QUALITY-SYNC-005 (drift covered by valid waiver) and GCLI-QUALITY-SYNC-006 (drift covered by expired waiver) are advisory anchors for the prototype's runtime contract; if a future runtime extraction lands, the matching CLI cases MUST be locked in the next golden CLI coverage extension lifecycle, not in TASK-1039.
interaction_notes.future_closure_snapshots: If a future v3.5.7+ closure snapshot is authored, it should reference this prototype path under capabilities (capability_id=waiver_policy_registry_prototype) and preserve runtime_consumption_authorized=false; the prototype is design-only and never authorizes runtime consumption.

future_runtime_extraction_acceptance_cri.evidence_required: future task adds a controlled negative case with a missing field and asserts the runner returns exit_code=1 with the listed reason_code.

future_runtime_extraction_acceptance_cri.evidence_required: future task adds a controlled negative case with an unknown field and asserts the runner returns exit_code=2.

limitations: TASK-1039 is design-only; this prototype does not authorize any runtime consumption.

The prototype mirrors the current waiver semantics observed in quality-gate-policy.v3.5.json, artifact-obligation-matrix.v3.5.json, evidence-ref-policy.v3.5.3.json, and golden-cli-coverage-matrix.v3.5.4.json; later edits to any of these source artifacts invalidate this prototype until re-validated.

The waiver_schema field list adds four lifecycle metadata fields (waiver_id, created_by_task, created_at, status) on top of the six fields recorded by the existing quality_gate_policy and AOM waiver_policy blocks; the four metadata fields are not enforced by current runtime and are introduced for future runtime extraction only.
reason_code allowed and rejected categories are conservative; future runtime extraction may extend the allowed set under a new decision artifact, but rejected_patterns must remain rejected.
scope_policy enumerates five shapes but the runtime matching algorithm is design-level; runtime mapping of scope to finding target is deferred to a future runtime extraction task.

expiration_policy.far_future_threshold (365 days) is advisory only; the prototype does not declare it blocking, and future runtime extraction may treat threshold breach as a warning rather than a fail-closed exit_code=2.
future_runtime_extraction_acceptance_criteria FE-1..FE-13 are forward-looking constraints; this prototype does not create the future task lifecycle and does not promise FE-* satisfaction.
non_authorization is explicit and load-bearing; any reading of this prototype as implicit authorization is incorrect.

This prototype lives under artifacts/governance/prototypes/ specifically to keep it out of the current quality-gate runner load path; it must not be moved into artifacts/governance/ without a separate decision artifact governing the move.

Schema validation of this prototype itself is performed only by the read-only inspection helper artifacts/verify/TASK-1039/inspect_waiver_policy_prototype.py and the inspection evidence JSON; no production runner or validator consumes it.

GCLI-QUALITY-SYNC-005 and GCLI-QUALITY-SYNC-006 cases recorded in golden-cli-coverage-matrix.v3.5.4.json remain implementation_authorized=false at TASK-1037 closure; the prototype's reason_code alignment is informative, not authoritative, until those cases are locked in a separate lifecycle.

QB-DRIFT-0001 (template_mirror_drift on test_guard_units.py) remains baseline_existing without remediation or waiver; the prototype does NOT issue a waiver for QB-DRIFT-0001 and does NOT lift the TASK-1038 closure-index non-authorization on QB-DRIFT-0001 remediation.
